source: Fresia et al. (2025), Fig. 4 on printed page 10. Vertices read visually from the published plot. SOC is the fraction at the beginning of each 30-minute slot, and power is grid-side kW. The authors' numerical curve file is unavailable.
reading_resolution: Rounded breakpoints at whole percentage points of SOC and whole kW. The 9% AC sensitivity in the test shifts only the first nonzero knot of the 10% drawing.
